name: Nerd Utility API
description: Free, no-auth utility micro-service for AI agents and developers. Data conversion (CSV/JSON, case, slugify), encoding & hashing (base64, sha256, md5, uuid, passwords), timestamps, text analysis, QR codes, DNS lookups, header inspection, web scraping, IP geolocation, crypto prices, JWT decoding, User-Agent parsing, and validation (email/url/ip/json/uuid/luhn). Plain JSON out, no keys or signup.

services.name: mcp
services.endpoint: stdio mcp-server.js — 20 tools wrapping the API

pricing: All endpoints free during growth phase.
